listing.name: Metroid Dread (Metroid-Dread-Recomp)
listing.summary: An early Metroid Dread port translating AArch64 code ahead of time to C, with native Vulkan/OpenGL services. The 0.x previews have setup problems, crashes and hardware limits; a proper 1.0 release is planned. The Windows x64 ZIP launcher bundles GCC/Python and compiles locally on first start, then manages updates and undo. Linux/Steam Deck scripts exist, but exact native Linux build and test coverage are unconfirmed. Use your own Metroid Dread 2.1.0 ExeFS, including main/main.npdm and companions, with complete update-merged RomFS. RomFS alone is insufficient; separate base/update dumps are accepted. No separate keys/firmware input is described after extraction, and region/executable hashes are unconfirmed. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
